newsitem.title: USA: DC council votes to privatize prison facility.
newsitem.headline: DC council votes to privatize prison facility.

text.p: In its largest privatization move to date, the District of Columbia council voted to hand over daily operations of the city's 900-bed Correctional Treatment Facility to the Corrections Corporation of America.
Under the plan, which must be cleared by the U.S. Congress, the district would sign a 20-year sale/lease-back pact with CCA, which currently operates near 57 corrections facility worldwide.

Backers of the plan said it would save the financially embattled city millions in operating costs. The corporation immediately would loan the city about $50 million, which the district would pay back interest-free over the next two decades.
